features: Trusted Brand -From America’s most trusted brand is engineered to work with HP printers to provide consistent quality, reliability and value
Value for Money: Get reliable printing and save more with Original HP Inks that print more pages than non-HP inks
Consistent Page Yield: Black cartridge yields ~480 pages and tri-colour yields ~150 pages (ISO/IEC 24711 test standard).
Lightning speed : HP Ink drops print 2,000 times faster with revolutionary technology for unmatched, high-quality prints.*
Easy Installation: Replace cartridges in seconds without mess or hassle
Memories that last:Our advanced technology creates 16.5 million vibrant colour combos in every 4x6 print - with 35 million ink drops.
True- to- life photos, school projects and documents. Whether it’s important documents for work, school projects, or cherished memories at home, HP ensures every print is crisp and true-to-life.

Protects Your Printer: Use Genuine HP cartridges from HP authorized partners to prevent printhead damage and keep your warranty valid. Choose Original HP Ink cartridges for fade-resistant printing of photos and documents that last generations with reliable and consistent performance
